stories.headline: Compact Fusion Reactor Achieves Sustained Net Energy Gain
stories.summary: Researchers announced a major step towards viable fusion power, with a new reactor design sustaining net energy for hours. This breakthrough could revolutionize global energy production and climate efforts.

stories.headline: EU Parliament Approves Landmark Digital Sovereignty Act
stories.summary: The legislation aims to reduce reliance on non-EU tech giants for critical infrastructure and data, impacting global tech firms and setting new standards for data governance across Europe.

stories.headline: Major Asian Manufacturing Hub Reports Unexpected Economic Slowdown
stories.summary: Official data from a key Asian economy shows a surprising contraction in manufacturing output for the third consecutive month, raising concerns about global supply chains and consumer demand.

stories.headline: Ceasefire Agreement Reached in East African Conflict Zone
stories.summary: Rival factions in a long-standing East African conflict have signed a UN-brokered ceasefire, offering hope for stability and humanitarian aid access after years of violence and displacement.

stories.headline: US Regulators Announce New AI Ethics Guidelines for Public Sector
stories.summary: New federal guidelines aim to ensure fairness, transparency, and accountability in AI systems used by government agencies, impacting development and deployment of artificial intelligence in public services.
